sketches.resonance: What has been released cannot be summoned back merely by naming it again.

sketches.mechanism: Non-strict evaluation: undefined may be passed to a function and remain harmless if the function never demands it.
sketches.resonance: A void can be present in the world so long as no one asks it to speak.
sketches.draft:
absence :: a
absence = undefined

world :: ()
world = const () absence

sketches.mechanism: An empty variant has no possible values, so a refutation case makes the match exhaustive by proving the branch unreachable.
sketches.resonance: For what can never arrive, even refusal is unnecessary.
sketches.draft:
type never = |

let answer (x : never) =
  match x with
  | _ -> .
